artiq_burst.why: back-to-back gates on one channel before a measurement (sequence-error / collision candidate)
artiq_burst.notes: Synthetic, written by the qtiming authors, NOT external code. The shipped ARTIQ contract publishes no gate or measure durations and no commit lead, so ARTIQ cells are `unsupported` until durations are assumed; on IBM the `exp` policy is rejected (policy-incompatible).
